company.title: Company & branding
company.subtitle: Your legal identity, the money rules, and which services you run
company.vatHint: Applied on top of every priced line.
company.vatRange: VAT must be a percentage between 0 and 100
company.savedDetail: New bookings use these figures immediately.
company.tradingNameHint: What customers and staff see across the platform.
company.servicesNote: Switching a service off hides it from the counter. A service with sessions still running cannot be switched off until they finish.
company.brandingNote: Your palette is applied from the tenant record at sign-in, so the whole platform re-skins for your company. Colour editing lives with your account manager for now.

people.title: Employees
people.subtitle: Everyone in your tenant, wherever they work
people.assetsSubtitle: Every unit you own, across every site
people.auditSubtitle: Every recorded action in your tenant, newest first
people.isolationSubtitle: What belongs to your tenant, and nothing else
people.noEmployeesHint: Create the first account under Accounts & roles.
people.noAuditHint: Overrides, refunds and asset changes appear here.
people.isolationNote: Scope comes from your sign-in token, not from anything the page asks for. There is no filter or address that widens it, so another company's data cannot appear here even by accident.

rules.title: Operating rules
rules.subtitle: The figures the floor runs on. Nothing here is fixed in code — change it between seasons.
rules.savedDetail: Every new session from now on uses these figures.
rules.resetDetail: Nothing is saved until you press Save.

clock.title: The clock
clock.blurb: How long a customer really has, and what a late return costs.
clock.graceHint: Overtime does not start until this has passed.
clock.statedGraceHint: Deliberately shorter, so they come back on time.
clock.graceMismatch: Telling the customer more than the system allows would cost them money.
clock.overtimeBlockHint: Once the grace is gone, time is charged in whole blocks of this size.
clock.replacementHint: The customer lost time to a fault that was not theirs.
clock.wrongStationHint: Charged when a vehicle comes back somewhere it did not leave from.

timers.title: When the clock starts
timers.blurb: Bag storage counts from the moment the bags are in; a rental counts from payment.
timers.startDelayHint: Time to walk the vehicle off the stand.
timers.explainPayment: The clock starts {{minutes}} minutes after the money lands.
timers.explainFulfilment: The clock starts when the thing changes hands.

penalties.title: Penalty schedule
penalties.blurb: What damage costs. A flat figure where every one is the same, the asset's own value where it is not.
penalties.label: Violation
penalties.incomplete: Every line needs a code and a description.
penalties.byAssetNote: Charged at whatever that particular asset is worth — a lost tuk-tuk is not a lost scooter.

map.title: Station map
map.subtitle: Place every station and desk where it stands, so the floor and the boats read the same map.
map.trayHint: Drag one onto the map, or drop it where it belongs.
map.empty: Drag a station or a desk from the right onto the map.
map.hint: Drag a marker to move it. The captain's chart and the lagoon route use these positions.
map.notSaved: The map could not be saved
